items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: No, not Raymond. Raymond Lopez. Raymond Lopez, no. No, Nicola Rocca. Raymond went up there too.

ctx.x: And that he wanted to play a clarinet. No. I think you're right. They couldn't afford a clarinet, but they got him a trumpet. And then one guy who later became famous with some man up in Chicago, who was the trumpet man there? I can't remember. He still left. Left and they couldn't get nobody else until he started playing trumpet. That's right. That's out. Who was the trumpet player with the Johnny Stein and Yellow Nunez band up there in Chicago? The original, original Dixie. Nicola Rocca. Was that Lopez? Nicola…
No, not Raymond. Raymond Lopez. Raymond Lopez, no. No, Nicola Rocca. Raymond went up there too. Nicola Rocca was with the... Before Nicola Rocca got it. Did Vega ever go anywhere?
No, Vega died before that started.
